specs.title: the walk page shows the open state with an empty chair
join: only Chogs that face the opener's are offered, the pledge is matched
I'm here with a note: the second arrival takes the step, the postmark lands, the calendar reminder downloads
a fan with no Chog and no walk lights a lantern and cheers, with transaction links
a missed day drifts them apart, the lantern keeps the next one, anyone can poke, walking away warns and ends it, the pledge is claimed
a full meeting: the last arrival uses the meeting gas path, both postcards decode on-chain, both Friend Books update
holder extras: only the holder sees the home-only switch, and a home-only Chog refuses everyone else with a sentence
rules broken through the UI show a sentence, not a hex string: a busy Chog
My walks lists the connected wallet's walks and today's to-do
an unknown walk and a missing wallet are handled honestly
the landing page: discovery numbers come from the collection data, the scroll story walks
copy rules hold in the rendered UI: no em or en dashes on any public page
the full loop on the local rules engine with real art
